label: HTTP endpoint to WhatsApp
info: Any system can send a WhatsApp message with one HTTP call: POST /whatsapp/alert.

name: Setup
info: Before you run this flow: open the Turbo Notify account node, paste an API key and press Test. Your Turbo Notify account needs a WhatsApp number linked to it. The key needs the messages:send scope. Call it with: curl -X POST http://localhost:1880/whatsapp/alert -H 'x-token: change-me' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"to":"+12025550123","message":"Backup finished"}'. The token is the ALERT_TOKEN variable of this tab (Flow properties): change it before you expose the endpoint. The answer is 202 with the message id, 400 for a bad body, 401 for a wrong token and 502 when Turbo Notify refuses the message.

name: check token and body
